scope: Muon.step only: communication, momentum and updates; no AdamW, forward/backward or grad reduction.
precision_scope: All Muon parameter shards and momentum, not samples. Effective update = final - initial.
protocol: BF16 params/gradients/state; no FP32 master. Timings use fixed gradients; precision uses identical changing gradients. Fresh state and same initial values per run.
